newsitem.title: USA: Muni sales total $1.9 bln for week of March 24.
newsitem.headline: Muni sales total $1.9 bln for week of March 24.

text.p: Municipal bond sales for the week of March 24 are expected to total $1.9 billion in 84 sales, according to Reuters Municipal Bond Information Group.
Negotiated offerings total $1.5 billion in 40 sales, with a $600 million Hawaii general obligation deal through Smith Barney Inc. topping the the list.
On the competitive side, 44 sales totaling $347 million are on the schedule, with a $45 million Oakland, Calif., deal on Wednesday the largest.
